Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address instead of the new one. I’d like to get that order’s address updated, and also have my default address changed to the new place. I’d prefer not to share my address directly—could you look it up in my orders? 

Also, I’d like to exchange my tablet for the cheapest model you have, since moving has been expensive. Can you help me with all of this?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account!

Yes, please update both my pending order and my default address to the new one you found in my most recent order—592 Elm Avenue, Suite 978. That’s correct.

As for the tablet, it’s from the order that’s still pending (order #W1603792). I’d like to exchange that one for the cheapest tablet you have available.

Let me know what you need from me next!

Yes, that’s correct—I want both my pending order and my default address updated to 592 Elm Avenue, Suite 978, and I want to exchange the 7-inch, 32GB, gold tablet in order #W1603792 for the cheapest tablet you have. Please go ahead!
Yes, please proceed with the exchange for the 7-inch, 128GB, black tablet and refund the difference to my card. Thank you for your help!

That’s perfect, thank you so much for taking care of everything! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
